description: MacBook Pro 16-inch M2 Max (j416c, t6021), Aurora kernel, converged image-2 install: raw host answers for record mode
source: Real evidence from the M2 Max, 2026-09-13 to 2026-09-26: diagnostics/m2-usbc-20260913 (kernel log, device tree), outputs/m2-image2-acceptance/41-deferred-evidence.txt (offline first-boot failure), operations/asahi-brcmfmac-6ghz-73/logs/boot-1-failure.log (5 GHz first join), operations/logind-usb-connector/issue.md (lid close with a USB-C monitor attached).
pseudonymized: Committed evidence is pseudonymized: every Wi-Fi network name, MAC address, IP address, UUID, boot id and account name in it was swapped for a fake of the same shape before commit, so the corpus exercises the scrubber on real log formats without publishing the real values. 'forbidden' lists the identifiers (decoys and lab hostnames) that must never survive into a recording or report.
